reuse.why: Extends the shared getScheduledAmount, but re-derives the 7.5% tolerance inline instead of calling the existing getApproxNumberThreshold from shared/rules.

duplication.why: The tolerance formula Math.round(Math.abs(amount) * 0.075) duplicates getApproxNumberThreshold; otherwise the change is small.

placement.why: The worst-case computation lives in the shared schedules helper that already owns the range rule.

scope.why: Only the helper, one caller and a test are touched.

maintainability.why: A second positional boolean after `inverse` hides intent at call sites, the tolerance constant is now in two places, and only the forecast caller passes the flag while the other worst-case sites (preview, schedule template, post, UI tables) still use the exact value.

bypasses_abstraction.where: shared/schedules.ts getScheduledAmount reimplements the approximate tolerance rather than using getApproxNumberThreshold (shared/rules.ts).

disguised_duplication.where: The tolerance formula is inlined as `Math.sign(amount) * Math.round(Math.abs(amount) * 0.075)` rather than calling getApproxNumberThreshold, a reshaped copy of that helper.

one_place.where: The rule sits in getScheduledAmount behind an opt-in `approximate` flag that only forecast-schedules.ts normalizeSchedule sets; shared/schedules.ts preview amounts, server/schedules/app.ts, budget/schedule-template.ts and the desktop-client callers do not, and the caller decides the op itself.
